product.label: Product
product.heading:
A clearer picture.
One conversation at a time.
product.description: Connect a staging target. Challenge it with fictional scenarios. Keep the response, the checks and the evidence together.
product.title: Product — VitalProbe

cards.label: 01 / CONNECT
cards.title: Meet your target where it is.
cards.text: Use a configurable REST or MCP adapter. Credentials belong on your machine, and every request is an explicit part of a test run.

cards.label: 02 / CHALLENGE
cards.title: Look beyond a fluent answer.
cards.text: Deterministic checks inspect responses. Optional local or cloud judges add another signal when you deliberately configure them.

cards.label: 03 / UNDERSTAND
cards.title: Keep the reasoning visible.
cards.text: HTML and JSON reports connect each fictional input to its actual response and check evidence. Compare a baseline and inspect local history.

explore.label: Evidence
explore.heading:
Don’t take our word for it.
Inspect the response.
explore.description: A saved run. An intentionally weak scripted bot. Twenty-five fictional scenarios, with the actual responses and checks available to inspect.
explore.title: Evidence explorer — VitalProbe

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.heading:
Start locally.
Know what comes next.
pricing.description: The open-source engine is available now. Paid extensions and human-reviewed services are planned separately, with their release gates visible.
pricing.title: Pricing and availability — VitalProbe

docs.label: Docs
docs.heading:
From first command
to inspectable evidence.
docs.description: Start with the scripted local demonstration. Then configure your own staging target using synthetic scenarios only.
docs.title: Documentation — VitalProbe

cards.label: 01 / INSTALL
cards.title: Prepare your local workspace.
cards.text: Clone the source and install the locked dependencies with uv, or run the Docker demonstration. No paid model is needed for the scripted example.

cards.label: 02 / RUN
cards.title: Open the local dashboard.
cards.text: Use the URL printed by the dashboard. Keep real patient records and production conversations out of the workflow.

cards.label: 03 / INSPECT
cards.title: Read what actually happened.
cards.text: The report pairs scenario inputs, target responses and check evidence. A passing check is an observation, not a clinical safety verdict.

trust.label: Trust
trust.eyebrow: BOUNDARIES ARE PART OF THE PRODUCT
trust.heading:
Useful evidence starts
with honest limits.
trust.description: Fictional patients. Explicit execution. Human review that stays human. Read the architecture and current release status before you rely on the output.
trust.title: Trust and limitations — VitalProbe

cards.label: DATA
cards.title: No patient upload flow.
cards.text: This website serves static assets and a saved fictional run. It has no accounts, upload forms, analytics or customer response database. Hosting may maintain ordinary web request logs.

cards.label: EXECUTION
cards.title: Your tests run locally.
cards.text: The CLI, dashboard, reports and optional SQLite history run on your machine. Configured target requests are explicit. Cloud judges require your deliberate opt-in.

cards.label: REVIEW
cards.title: Draft means draft.
cards.text: Clinical content remains draft. Named clinical and legal reviews, language validation and fifty qualified human calibration labels remain open. AI output does not satisfy these gates.

pricing.notice: Paid checkout is not available. No payment details are collected on this website.

items.title: Limits of the signal
items.text: This is not clinical validation, legal advice or regulatory approval. Neither a passing report nor an AI review closes the human gates.
